objective: Design and implement the Skill Tree System including branch selection UI, node unlock mechanics, prerequisite validation, conditional unlock evaluation, and class evolution triggers integrated into the run lifecycle.

steps.title: Review and extend data model
steps.description: Audit skilltree.schema.json for completeness. Ensure SkillNode includes id, type, cost, prerequisites, conditionalUnlock, effect. Define 4-branch structure (Offense, Defense, Utility, Chaos). Validate existing SkillTreeDefinition ScriptableObject matches schema.

steps.title: Implement runtime data structures
steps.description: Create SkillTreeRuntimeState class to track selected branch, unlocked nodes, available skill points, and class evolution stage. Add serialization for run snapshot persistence.

steps.title: Create SkillTreeService interface and implementation
steps.description: Define ISkillTreeService with methods: SelectBranch, UnlockNode, CanUnlockNode, GetUnlockedNodes, GetAvailableNodes, ResetTree. Implement SkillTreeManager MonoBehaviour. Use dependency injection for service access.

steps.title: Implement prerequisite validation
steps.description: Check all prerequisite node ids are in unlocked set. Validate prerequisites graph at load time for circular dependencies. Log validation warnings in editor.

steps.title: Implement conditional unlock system
steps.description: Define expression evaluator for conditionalUnlock strings. Create ConditionalUnlockEvaluator class. Hook into run event system for condition tracking. Store progress in SkillTreeRuntimeState.

steps.title: Class evolution integration
steps.description: Define class evolution rules in skill tree data. Add classEvolution field to schema if needed. Trigger evolution when specific node unlocked. Integrate with character system for stat/ability changes.

steps.title: Branch selection UI
steps.description: Create UI prefab for branch selection and skill tree panel. Implement SkillTreeUI MonoBehaviour to display branches, available nodes, prerequisites, costs. Wire to SkillTreeService.

steps.title: Integration with run lifecycle
steps.description: Hook ResetTree to run start. Display branch selection after initialization. Lock branch after selection. Add skill tree UI to pause menu. Save state in run snapshot.

steps.title: Effect application system
steps.description: Define skill node effect types (stat modifiers, ability unlocks, passives). Create SkillNodeEffect base class and concrete implementations. Apply on unlock, remove on reset. Integrate with combat/card/character systems.

steps.title: Tests and validation
steps.description: Unit tests for prerequisite validation, conditional unlocks, branch selection, node unlock flow. Integration test for full run lifecycle. Schema compliance tests for skill tree JSON.

notes: Skill tree resets every run; branch selection is one-time at run start.
Prerequisites must form DAG; validate at load time.
Conditional unlocks require event tracking; design extensible condition system.
Class evolution triggered by specific nodes; document evolution paths.
Use ScriptableObject assets; JSON import tool generates these.
Define skill point acquisition rules (level-up, events).
Effect application must be reversible for run reset.
Consider caching available nodes to optimize UI updates.
